# Ecto SQLite3 v0.24.1 - Table of Contents

> An SQLite3 Ecto3 adapter.

## Modules

- [Ecto.Adapters.SQLite3](https://ecto-sqlite3.hexdocs.pm/Ecto.Adapters.SQLite3.md): Adapter module for SQLite3.
- [Ecto.Adapters.SQLite3.TypeExtension](https://ecto-sqlite3.hexdocs.pm/Ecto.Adapters.SQLite3.TypeExtension.md): A behaviour that defines the API for extensions providing custom data loaders and dumpers
for Ecto schemas.
